---
title: "Maillage visuel des sitous"
editor: visual
lang: fr-FR
format:
  pdf:
    pdf-engine: xelatex
    number-sections: true
    fig-align: left
    fig-width: 7
    fig-height: 5
    fig-format: png
    papersize: A4
    mainfont: "Calibri"
    include-in-header: 
      text: |
        \usepackage{fancyhdr}
        \usepackage{graphicx}
        \usepackage{lastpage}
        \usepackage{xcolor}
        \pagestyle{fancy}
        \fancyhf{}

geometry: "left=1cm,right=1cm,top=0cm,bottom=1cm"
execute:
  echo: false
  cache: false
  message: false
  warning: false
output: 
  df_print: kable
---
